title.lead: Get noticed for a project that

builders.lede: Idem Builders showcases African projects run with IDEM: put online, marketed and developed here. Submit yours; the team reviews it and replies by email.
builders.seeShowcase: See the projects in the programme

member.title: You are an Idem Builder
member.topup: +{{percent}}% credit on every top-up, already applied
member.showcase: Your project is featured on idem.africa/builders
member.portrait: A possible feature on IDEM's blog and social channels

badge.title: The Idem Builder badge
badge.body: Paste this code in your site's footer: the badge links to the programme showcase.

mine.title: Your applications

apply.title: Submit a project
apply.subtitle: One condition: the project is run with IDEM. Pick it, and we check what it already does here.
apply.noProject: You don't have a project yet. Create it, run it with IDEM, then come back to submit it.
apply.checkError: This project cannot be checked right now.
apply.alreadyMember: This project is already in the programme.
apply.alreadyPending: An application for this project is already in review.
apply.notEligible: This project is not run with IDEM yet. Put it online with iDeploy or manage its marketing in IDEM, then come back: either one is enough.
apply.pitch: How does your project put Africa forward?
apply.pitchHelp: The problem you solve, for whom, where. This is what the team reads before deciding.
apply.sentBody: The team reviews it within {{days}} working days. You will get the answer by email, and it will show here.

terms.accept: I have read and accept the
terms.note: Your agreement is recorded with the application (text version, date, IP address, browser).

publication.title: What the public will see
publication.body: The project page will show its name, description, country, address, your presentation and its brand identity (logo, colours, typefaces).
publication.team: Also show the project team: names, roles, photos and professional links
publication.teamNote: Each person shown must agree. Email addresses are never published.

welcome.title: {{amount}} F on us
welcome.body: Added to your wallet when accepted, once per account.

topup.title: +{{percent}}% on every top-up
topup.body: Stacks with the tier bonus, for as long as you are a member.

hosting.title: -{{percent}}% on hosting
hosting.body: The iDeploy meters of your sites and apps cost less every day.

showcase.title: A place in the showcase
showcase.body: Your project presented on idem.africa/builders, with a link to it.

portrait.title: A feature in our channels
portrait.body: The team regularly picks projects to tell on IDEM's blog and social channels.

badge.title: The Idem Builder badge
badge.body: Put it on your site to show you are part of it.
